summary: Make differences interpretable by holding the relevant viewing conditions consistent.
objective: Make differences interpretable by holding the relevant viewing conditions consistent.
example_prompts: Use controlled comparison stage for the scene, preserving its model and user controls.

principles: Choose which variable changes and which conditions remain fixed before designing the comparison.
A reference view should help interpretation rather than double all visual clutter.
implementation: Use aligned axes, shared scales and compatible camera framing when comparing quantities.
Keep a ghost reference, split view or explicit toggle according to occlusion and screen space.
Annotate any independently normalized scale or changed illumination that affects interpretation.
observable_checks: The reported difference comes from the selected variable, not an undisclosed scale or camera change.
Reset restores the same comparison baseline.

creative_affordances: Adapt the layout, visual treatment and timing to the task; these are reusable design proposals, not mandatory templates.
known_limits: Authored interaction/presentation guidance; no new scientific claim, accessibility certification or runtime verification is asserted.
